Subject: Discontinuation of Branch Change from Academic Year 2026–27 in UG
Programs.
The Senate, in its 43rd Meeting held on 27-28 October 2025, approved the
proposal to discontinue the provision of branch change in UG Programs at IIT Jodhpur
from the new admissions starting Academic Year 2026-27 onwards.
Accordingly, all students admitted in 2026 and thereafter shall continue in their
original allotted branches during admission at IIT Jodhpur and will not be able to change
their JoSAA-allocated branch.

parts.text:
Based on the search results, it appears that the branch change option for B.Tech. students has been discontinued from Academic Year 2026-27 onwards. This is stated in Circular-Discontinuation of Branch Change from Academic Year 202-27 in UG Programs (DOC0031), which states that "all students admitted in 2026 and thereafter shall continue in their original allotted branches during admission at IIT Jodhpur and will not be able to change their JoSAA-allocated branch."

Additionally, Circular 57 Revised guidelines for Branch-Change of B.Tech. students (DOC0030) states that "no option of branch change be allowed post second year. Accordingly, the branch change option available to Engineering Science Students post their second year is discontinued."

Therefore, the answer to the question is that the B.Tech. branch change has been discontinued for Academic Year 2026-27.
